input.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: iPhone net sales increased during the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025 due to higher net sales of Pro models.

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that the increase in Apple's iPhone net sales in the quarter ended December 27, 2025 was due mainly to higher sales of Pro models. This is an interpretive claim about the driver/cause of the increase rather than a numeric assertion. Evidence E1, from Apple's 10-Q filing for the period ended December 27, 2025, directly states: "iPhone net sales increased during the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025 due to higher net sales of Pro models." This passage explicitly attributes the iPhone net sales increase to higher Pro model sales, which directly supports the claim. The claim is therefore SUPPORTED by the evidence.
